rules.statement: The RTL must follow the VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2 (REF-003) as the mandatory coding authority.
The RTL must comply with REF-003 except for the single deviation DEC-021 (PRT-03).
RTL must use one module per file with file name equal to module name, a structural top, ANSI ports with input wire and output logic, and reg_, w_, p_ff_, p_com_ naming.
FSMs must be named reg_fsm_hs_current_state and w_fsm_hs_nxt_state with ENUM_ST_* state names.
Parameters must be named PARA_APBCDC_* with the three PAR-02 comment lines; names at most 30 characters; NAM-08 abbreviations used, with payload written in full.
Cell instances must be named u_dont_touch_ followed by the function and only inside the wrapper; comment lines at most 100 characters; port layout and grouping follow REF-003 FIL-05 and FIL-06.
Every flip-flop must have an asynchronous reset to 0.
SVA, testbench or prototype code must not be in the synthesis file list.
The register and instance names used by the SDC must be kept as named in the RTL.
m_vlsit_apbcdc_top must be the structural top holding ports, parameters, interconnect and instances.
m_vlsit_apbcdc_mst must be the requester-side block in CLK-MST/RST-MST and m_vlsit_apbcdc_slv the completer-side block in CLK-SLV/RST-SLV, instantiated in the top.
Synchronizers must be m_vlsit_apbcdc_sync instances in the destination domain (mst: u_sync_ack; slv: u_sync_req, u_sync_wk), built per bit from m_vlsit_apbcdc_cell_sync wrappers.
State must be owned only by the mst block, the slv block and the synchronizers as listed.
There must be no register logic and no protocol adapter other than the two FSMs.
Internal module ports must use the Section 6.2 columns, types and APB port names, with internal bundle widths LPARA_REQ_W and LPARA_RESP_W.
o_req must be a flop output launched at the Setup edge, resetting to 0, toggling per transfer in two-phase and high during the request phase in four-phase.

rules.condition: From launch of o_req until the acknowledge was seen
rules.statement: o_req_payload must be the hold register loaded at the Setup edge, reset 0, valid and stable.
o_wakeup must be a flop output registering i_apb_pwakeup one cycle later, with reset value 0.
i_ack must be synchronized in CLK-MST through the first synchronizer stage from the slv launch flop.
i_resp_payload must be valid and stable when the acknowledge event is seen and loaded in CLK-MST at that edge.
i_req must be synchronized in CLK-SLV via the first synchronizer stage from the mst launch flop.
i_req_payload must be valid and stable when the request event is seen and loaded in CLK-SLV at that edge.
i_wakeup must be synchronized in CLK-SLV via the first synchronizer stage from the mst launch flop.
o_ack must be a flop output launched at the edge that sees i_apb_pready, reset 0, toggling per transfer in two-phase and high during the acknowledge phase in four-phase.

rules.condition: From launch of o_ack until the next request event
rules.statement: o_resp_payload must be the hold register loaded at the edge that sees i_apb_pready, reset 0, valid and stable.
m_vlsit_apbcdc_sync must sample i_data at every i_clk_dst edge, with o_data from the last stage, N stages later, resetting to 0 on active-low i_rst_n_dst.
m_vlsit_apbcdc_cell_sync must be a one-bit wrapper with i_d, o_q, PARA_APBCDC_CELL_TYPE and PARA_APBCDC_CELL_RST_VAL set to 0 for all control bits.
Pin and cell names of library cells may keep the library style and are exempt from the naming rule.
Synthesis must use top m_vlsit_apbcdc_top with the listed files and configurations, and define VLSIT_SYNTHESIS for synthesis, lint, CDC and formal.
